ueber_uns.values_2_body: 12 months on part and labour. If something fails again, we repair it for free.
ueber_uns.values_3_body: We don't touch storage unless we have to. GDPR-compliant, media wiped after handover.
ueber_uns.values_4_body: Part, labour, tax — all in the fixed price. Free pickup from € 70 repair value.
